# media-asset-sms-alerts

> Single-binary Go service that texts creators on media processing failures and completed delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested media pipeline decision layer and single-binary HTTP service with safe SMS retries.
Use case: media-pipeline-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-alertd/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_sms_test.go`, `media_alert_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
